name: Zimmah
overview: The name Zimmah appears in Scripture as a significant genealogical marker within the tribe of Levi, specifically among the Gershonites. He is identified as a son of Jahath, situating him in the Levitical lineage (1 Chronicles 6:20), and is also noted as the father of descendants such as Ethan and Joah, who continued the Gershonite heritage (1 Chronicles 6:42; 2 Chronicles 29:12). These references highlight Zimmah’s role in the preservation and transmission of Levitical responsibilities and priestly service, underscoring the importance of faithful lineage in God’s covenant community.
